meta.title: Hafr — Your family name, carved to stay
meta.description: Exterior signage cut in metal for UAE villas: house numbers, family names in Arabic, flag and family-crest pieces, gate and boundary-wall panels, and plot-entrance monuments.

stage.headline: Your family name, carved to stay.

make.title: What we make
make.intro: Pieces made for your wall: measured to it, set in the script you choose, and built to stay at the entrance to your home.

items.name: House numbers
items.desc: Cut metal numerals, raised off the wall, in Arabic digits, Latin digits or both.

items.name: Family and owner names
items.desc: Your family name in Arabic, with a Latin transliteration if you want one, checked and approved before anything is cut.

items.name: Flag and family-crest pieces
items.desc: Cut crests and flag pieces for the gate, with flag poles.

items.name: Gate and boundary-wall panels
items.desc: Cut panels and screens made to the exact measurements of your boundary wall.

items.name: Plot-entrance monuments
items.desc: Freestanding monuments at the entrance to the plot, installed by our team.

make.also: From the same workshop: cut wall art for interiors.

built.title: Built to stay outside
built.intro: Gulf summers, sun, salt and humidity find every shortcut, so every piece is specified for what it will actually face.

rows.fail: Printed faces that chalk and fade in the sun
rows.build: Finishes chosen to hold their colour in Gulf sun

rows.fail: Thin sheets that bend in the heat and lift at the fixings
rows.build: Thickness matched to the size of each piece

rows.fail: Metal that rusts near the sea and stains the wall
rows.build: Metal chosen by the plot's distance from the sea

rows.fail: Fixings that rust before the sign does
rows.build: Fixings matched to the piece, so they don't stain the wall

rows.fail: Lights that cook in a 50°C summer and fail one letter at a time
rows.build: Sealed lighting rated for 50°C, with a driver that can be reached

rows.fail: Flush mounting that traps water and stains a rectangle on the wall
rows.build: Mounted 15 to 25 mm off the wall, for drainage, air and a true shadow line

built.fallback: Every piece is specified for 45 to 50°C summers, intense sun, coastal salt, seasonal humidity and winter sand.

name.title: The name is the piece
name.intro: Arabic letters change shape with their position, and one wrong form is obvious to everyone who passes your gate. So nothing reaches the machine until you have approved it in writing.

steps.title: You type the name
steps.text: In Arabic, yourself. We never transcribe it from a voice note.

steps.title: You choose a setting
steps.text: Two or three treatments of your actual name, not a sample.

steps.title: You see it on your wall
steps.text: At true proportions with dimensions marked, on a photo of your own wall where possible.

steps.title: You sign it off
steps.text: Your written approval is dated and kept with the job.

steps.title: A second reading
steps.text: Another Arabic reader checks the proof against the text you sent, before anything is cut.

steps.title: Cut, finished, photographed
steps.text: The file is locked, then the piece is cut, finished and photographed before it ships.

dark.title: After dark
dark.intro: Lit from behind, the name floats on the wall. Lit from the front, it reads from the street.
dark.lighting: Sealed LED modules made for 50°C summers, with the driver placed where it can be reached, so a service is a quick swap rather than taking the piece down.
dark.fallback: Pieces can be lit from behind or from the front, to suit the wall and the street.

kit.title: Delivered ready to fit
kit.intro: Every piece arrives with everything needed to fit it:
items: A full-size drilling template, with the drill size printed on it
Anchors for UAE block-and-render walls, plus spares
The right key or bit for the fixings
Photo instructions in Arabic and English
Protective film that comes off last
kit.fallback: Every piece arrives ready to fit, or we install it on request.
kit.install: Prefer we fit it? Installation is available on request.
kit.install_standard: Gate and wall panels, screens and plot-entrance monuments are always installed by the Hafr team.

start.title: Start with a photo of your wall
send: A photo of the gate or wall
What the wall is made of
Which way the wall faces (for sun and shadow)
Whether there is power nearby (for lighting)
